17. Severity vs priority
Severity is impact; priority is urgency or order of fixing.
Severity එJකන් bug එJක් බලපෑම මනිනවා. Priority එJකන් Jකාච්චර ඉක්මනට හදන්න ඕනද
Launch-page typo can be low severity but high priority; payment loss is high severity.
